_note: Seminar listings split by academic year (August-July). Add a year to `years` and put its talks in data/talks/<yy-yy>/talks.json. The site loads every listed year, splits Upcoming vs Past from each talk date (America/New_York), and sorts them. Fields: speaker, speaker_url, institution, title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), time, location, image, alt, abstract, bio, url.
